$meta.purpose: Authoritative allow-list of the vec_dot MONOLITH block-dot op-defs that are ALLOWED to still exist in the ODS (include/TianChenRV/Dialect/RVV/IR/RVVOps.td). Every surviving monolith is either (a) DELIBERATELY RETAINED forever (a live second lowering path / a negative control), or (b) PENDING RETIREMENT under a NAMED batch. An op-def that survives with NEITHER classification is the unnamed dead tail this list exists to forbid ('有名有批次': a monolith may linger only if it is named AND carries a retirement batch). The machine gate tools/lint/check_monolith_retire.py fails closed on any un-whitelisted surviving monolith.
constitution: A 'vec_dot monolith' = an ODS op-def whose description says 'Records the COMPLETE ggml `ggml_vec_dot_<fmt>_<act>` (super-)block dot-product as ONE ...' — the WHOLE ggml vec_dot recorded as ONE opaque op. Bricks/cores ('Records the INTEGER CORE ...' / 'Records the WHOLE per-super-block body ...') and the GEMM/GEMV/REPACK/PACK family are NOT monoliths and are out of scope.

deliberately_retained = a monolith that will NEVER be retired: it backs a live emission/isa path (q4_0 contraction arm) or is a deliberate undecomposed negative control (mxfp4). No batch pointer — it is not going away.

pending_retirement = a monolith the front door has already SUPERSEDED (it constructs a typed body instead) but whose op-def still lingers because a live secondary ref (a front-door opName string key, a still-live monolith emitter, or a verifier dataflow contract test) has not yet been migrated. MUST carry a batch pointer naming the retirement campaign + the proven precedent to follow.

The gate is fail-closed in BOTH directions: an ODS monolith absent from this list => RED (unnamed dead tail); a list entry whose op-def no longer exists in ODS => RED (stale whitelist — a retired op must be MOVED to retired_ledger, keeping the live list == the exact surviving set).
Retired verifiers are PLAIN-DELETED from the .cpp (git history is the archive). An `#if 0 ... GgmlBlockDot*::verify ... #endif` tomb left in a dialect/conversion .cpp is itself a residual and is RED.
